owner: Volta owns the FORM of a skip token and this registry; the verdict colour comes from the class, and a class is not author-assignable
measured_alphabet_command: for r in $(git for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)' | head -40); do git diff --no-color <integration-HEAD>..$r -- '*.go'; done | grep -ho 'SKIP_[A-Z]*\[tag=[a-z0-9_]*\]' | sort -u

class_meaning.real_store_env: an object store was not supplied; red at a full environment
class_meaning.database_env: a database was not supplied; red at a full environment
class_meaning.trusted_parser_env: the trusted artifact parser is not available; red at a full environment
class_meaning.harness_toolchain_env: a harness interpreter or tool is absent; red at a full environment
class_meaning.harness_precondition_env: the leg cannot be attempted for a harness reason (missing checkout object, evidence path, git metadata); red at a full environment
class_meaning.opt_in_only: nobody turned a switch on: that is a CHOICE, so the token must be SKIP_EXPLICIT, never SKIP_ENV

artifact_plane.note: the object-store dependency; permission to write it is declared per lane via AHP_TEST_OBJECT_STORE, not inherited from the environment

postgres.note: forward name for the database dependency: a tag names the dependency, not the lane and not a bundle of dependencies

database.note: COND-5: emitted on heisenberg/volta-conditions-on-34aed0fe; registered so the mechanism does not refuse a real measurement during the rename, and scheduled for rename by the owning lane

real_deps.note: an umbrella over several dependencies: it cannot be counted, because one token does not say what was not covered. Frozen as-is, no new emissions under this name

source_revision.note: the candidate revision is not in this checkout; a real precondition, stated rather than guessed

dot_e2e_optin.note: form correction requested: reason=leg_opt_in_only means nobody opted in. That is a choice, and SKIP_ENV is reserved for 'nobody supplied the dependency'. While registered it counts as yellow (never green), which is the safe colour either way

dot_e2e_llm.note: the live personal-Dot leg cannot be attempted without AHP_LLM_MODEL. Registered by the dictionary owner BEFORE the lane that emits it, because an unregistered tag is UNKNOWN_SKIP_TAG and that red belongs to the mechanism, not to the honest leg. The class was fixed by the director when dispatching this lane: at an acceptance environment the model IS required to be supplied, so a skip here must read red, which is what harness_precondition_env means. The class name does not itself colour anything -- scripts/skip-verdict.mjs colours on the KIND (SKIP_ENV_AT_FULL_ENV fires for any skip_env row once the run declares a complete environment), measured at 9916e0b8

secret_store_dir.note: the sweep over real credential stores has no subject until the operator supplies AHP_SECRET_STORE_DIR; the leg says SKIP_ENV out loud and never PASS. Same class and the same reasoning as dot_e2e_llm: a subject the operator must supply, absent => not-covered => red at a full environment

git_worktree.note: git metadata is not mounted (a read-only source mount inside a test image): the leg skips visibly instead of passing vacuously
